scope: boundary edges only; no lexical targets, background or phrase CTC
supervision: start/end positives; negatives only inside accepted intervals; all other values ignored

blockers: Existing recipes require excluded NCSLGR/OTHER validation sources; update objective/selection metrics.
Blank/rest supervision and unseen-OOV evaluation are not approved; auxiliary training inputs must be pinned before enabling training.

observer_contract.timebase: source timestamps, same live processing scheduler; no synthetic rate change
observer_contract.lip_nodes: observed as in live input; no source-specific masking

selection: minimum parent-held training-calibration edge BCE; validation never selects epochs
limitation: No independently annotated low-motion/hold/repeat phone set; long events over1.2s excluded by inherited quality contract; no supervised outside class.
